_fixture.note: Derived, not recorded. The recorded captures predate `fps`, `tbr`, `vcodec` and `acodec` on a format (SEC-002: a fixture carries only what the projection reads, and the projection did not read them until T-107). REQ-003 names all four as columns, so the format table's tests need a fixture that has them. This is that fixture, and it is NOT evidence for Phase 3's exit criterion 1 — matching `yt-dlp -F` needs a recorded capture, which T-185 owns. As of T188-R1 it is no longer the evidence for REQ-008's merge pair - dash_akamai_big_buck_bunny is, and it is recorded. It keeps the synthetic pair only for the pairable-with-a-complete-format combination the format table needs and no recorded source can supply.

_fixture.why_this_source: The same public-domain item the recorded capture uses, so the shape is real; only the fields the recorded capture could not carry are synthetic. formats[5] carries neither fps nor bitrate nor size, so the table's placeholder path has a row. formats[6] names a vcodec and no acodec at all - media.ccc.de's real shape for a video recording - which is UNKNOWN rather than video-only, because the file certainly has sound and nothing said so; it is here because a mutation reading that as video-only survived every other fixture. formats[7] is an HLS audio rendition - `vcodec: none` with no acodec at all, which is what a real EXT-X-MEDIA:TYPE=AUDIO group produces - and formats[8] denies both streams, as a storyboard does. The first is the audio half; the second is neither half. Both boundaries were found by driving a real local HLS presentation through yt-dlp for T108-R1. THOSE FOUR SHAPES ARE WHY THIS FIXTURE REMAINS: no recorded source happens to publish them. formats[3] and formats[4] are still an explicitly audio-only and an explicitly video-only stream, and they are still synthetic - which is why what_is_synthetic still declares them. They are NO LONGER THE EVIDENCE FOR REQ-008's PAIR: dash_akamai_big_buck_bunny is a recorded source that publishes the real thing, and tests/unit/test_format_selection.py reads it for every routing, slot, mode and ffmpeg assertion. WHAT THEY REMAIN FOR IS ONE COMBINATION NO RECORDED SOURCE CAN SUPPLY: a fixture that is PAIRABLE and also contains COMPLETE formats. tests/ui/test_format_table.py needs both at once - pairability is what makes the mode control exist, and a complete format inside the same source is what T-075's refusal has to refuse. dash_akamai_big_buck_bunny is pairable and has ZERO complete formats, and that is structural rather than incidental: DASH separates the streams by construction, which is the very property that makes it the merge-pair evidence. A recorded source cannot be both, so removing these two costs five format-table cases - measured, not assumed (T188-R1, commit 1ba5f73 is the attempt). This block previously said NO acceptable recorded source supplies the pair, that T-188 owned that search, and that OPS-013 permitted the gap; the search finished on 2026-08-08 and the gap is closed.
